name: EPIC 201328572
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 17.6 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201328572 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 17.636771 (16th-84th percentiles 16.792691-18.881511), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,286 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.81 solar masses and 17.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,766 K at its surface.
